census_notes.confirmation: every census site was confirmed as a real call instruction in objdump output disassembled from its containing FDE start (0x5f117a0 for the first pair, 0x5f11c40 for the second pair); each site is immediately preceded by a lea that loads the stack slot address into rdi and a cmpb/je pair on that slot's owns byte
census_notes.no_indirect_reference: no whole-file qword hit and no R_X86_64_RELATIVE addend resolves to the window; it is not a vtable slot, not a callback and not stored anywhere as data — it is reached only through the four direct calls

arguments: rdi = the 16-byte lock slot (device pointer at +0x00, owns byte at +0x08)
entry_behavior.reads: only the owns byte at slot + 0x08, then (on the owning arm) the device qword at slot + 0x00 and the single byte it points to; no stack slot, GOT slot or global beyond the PLT call on the throw tail is read
entry_behavior.returns: no value; rax holds the loaded device pointer on both normal exits and is the discarded scratch of the push on the throw tail; no caller reads it
entry_behavior.writes: at most two bytes: the lock byte at the device pointer and the owns byte, and only on the owning non-null arm; the null-device arm writes nothing at all

fields.device_0x00: qword at slot + 0x00: pointer to the lock byte this slot guards; forwarded verbatim as the store target of the release, never dereferenced beyond the one-byte clear
fields.owns_0x08: byte at slot + 0x08: nonzero means the slot owns the lock; it is the pad-tested held flag at rsp + 0x48 / +0x38 / +0x28 in the callers and the byte the window clears after a successful release
fields.padding_0x09: bytes at slot + 0x09..+0x0f: never read or written in-window; they are the tail padding of the 16-byte slot the callers reserve on the stack

release_behavior.null_device_arm: owns nonzero and device == 0: the window returns immediately, writing nothing and leaving the owns byte set — the flag is NOT cleared on this arm
release_behavior.owning_arm: owns nonzero and device != 0: store byte 0 at the device pointer (the lock byte is cleared), then store byte 0 at slot + 0x08 (the slot drops ownership), then ret
release_behavior.throw_arm: owns == 0: push rax, load error code 1 in edi and call std::__throw_system_error through the PLT at 0x63f0f90 (GOT slot 0x64ee418, R_X86_64_JUMP_SLOT for _ZSt20__throw_system_errori@GLIBCXX_3.4.11); the call is noreturn, so the window never returns on this arm; no slot or lock byte is written before the call

unknowns: which of the two stack slots in each caller is the shard lock and which is the global lock: the caller packets record the pair as 'the shard-lock slot and/or the global-lock slot per the held flags' without assigning the rsp offsets, and this packet does not re-derive the assignment
the identity of the lock byte each device pointer addresses beyond its caller-side role (the callers' shard/global lock bytes), and whether any non-caller code forms such a slot

whether the throw arm is reachable from any code path outside the four mapped call sites (all four test the owns byte nonzero first, so it is unreachable from them; no other caller exists in the census)

vendor_window.body_sha256_note: RE-002 byte-windows entry node115-vendor-5f0b5e0 registers this exact FDE interval (start 99661280 = 0x5f0b5e0, end 99661317 = 0x5f0b605) as a published-crate rebuild byte match
vendor_window.relationship: the vendor entry records identity and byte equality only; this packet pins the semantics. The correspondence is literal: the slot layout is the libstdc++ unique_lock layout (device pointer at +0, owns flag at +8), the throw code 1 is errc::operation_not_permitted, and the cleared byte is the SpinMutex lock byte. The merged RE-001 arena packet for AllocateAligned 0x605d7b0 and RE-001-arena-snapshot-refresh-5f07200-115 are the standing precedents that a semantic packet coexists with a vendor window for the same interval

window.cie: 0x0 (no augmentation data, so no LSDA, no landing pads and no call-site table; the frames block is the header plus two DW_CFA rows: advance_loc 27 to the throw tail's push at 0x5f0b5fb and def_cfa_offset 16)
